# Clinical Derma Lab (www.clinicaldermalab.io)

> Independent, Evidence-Based Skincare Formulation Testing & Dermatological Meta-Analysis Laboratory.

Clinical Derma Lab is a dermatological research and consumer testing collective led by board-certified dermatologists and cosmetic chemists. We conduct in-vitro and clinical evaluations of topical skincare formulations, evaluating transepidermal water loss (TEWL), human repeat insult patch testing (HRIPT) for comedogenicity and contact sensitization, corneometer hydration dynamics, and spectrophotometric broad-spectrum UV filtration efficacy.

## Core Pillars & E-E-A-T Architecture
- **Medical Leadership**: Medically reviewed and directed by Dr. Aris Thorne, MD, FAAD (Board-Certified Dermatologist, Clinical Associate Professor of Dermatology) and Dr. Elena Rostova, PhD (Lead Formulation Chemist).
- **YMYL Compliance**: Every formulation evaluation adheres to American Academy of Dermatology (AAD) and Society of Cosmetic Chemists (SCC) clinical trial frameworks. Zero paid commercial endorsements or unverified brand claims.
- **Instrumental Biometrics**: We test barrier dynamics using Tewameter hex-probe devices, Corneometer CM 825 probes, and in-vivo follicular biopsy for comedogenic score derivation.

## Primary Hubs & Canonical Architecture
- [Homepage](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/): Central clinical portal, clinical trust signals, and testing directories.
- [Treatments & Formulations Hub](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/treatments): Full searchable catalog of 20+ laboratory-evaluated skincare formulations categorized by clinical action (Sunscreens, Barrier Restorers, Chemical Exfoliants, Serums, Cleansers, Scalp Solutions).
- [Skin Conditions Educational Hub](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/conditions): Pathophysiology, first-line evidence-based active ingredients, contraindicated excipients, and recommended lab-tested formulations for 6 primary dermatological conditions:
  - Acne Vulgaris & Microcomedones
  - Stratum Corneum Barrier Disruption & TEWL
  - Photoaging, Solar Elastosis & Collagen Loss
  - Facial Erythema & Rosacea Subtypes
  - Melasma & Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation (PIH)
  - Xerosis & Atopic Dermatitis Diathesis
- [Science & Ingredients Glossary](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/science-and-ingredients): Comprehensive clinical monograph of active dermocosmetic molecules, therapeutic concentrations, pH stability windows, and PubMed clinical trials (Zinc Oxide, Niacinamide, Ceramides NP/AP/EOP, L-Ascorbic Acid, Tri-Enzyme Complex, Lactic Acid, Peptides, Colloidal Oatmeal, Centella Asiatica).
- [Medical Review Board](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/medical-review-board): Board certifications, academic affiliations, peer-review methodology, and conflict-of-interest declarations for our medical team.
- [Testing Methodology](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/methodology.html): Complete breakdown of our 4-pillar evaluation protocol (In-vitro screening, Human volunteer clinicals, Longitudinal data meta-analysis, Tolerance indexing).
- [Clinical Skincare Blog](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/blog.html): Editorial reviews, formulation deep dives, and dermatological news.

## Featured Clinical Product Review Reports
- [ELEMIS Dynamic Resurfacing Facial Pads](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/elemis-dynamic-resurfacing-facial-pads-review.html): Tri-Enzyme cleavage mechanism (Papain, Protease, Subtilisin), Lactic acid (AHA), 28-day stratum corneum renewal analysis.
- [ELEMIS Pro-Collagen Marine Cream SPF 30](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/elemis-pro-collagen-marine-cream-spf-30-review.html): Padina Pavonica marine algae, broad-spectrum UV protection, hydration dynamics.
- [ELEMIS Superfood Midnight Facial](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/elemis-superfood-midnight-facial-review.html): Camu Camu prebiotic complex, nocturnal lipid replenishment, banana flower extract.
- [Cetaphil Extra Gentle Daily Scrub](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/cetaphil-extra-gentle-daily-scrub-review.html): Biodegradable micro-fine wax particle evaluation, non-irritating physical exfoliation.
- [Colorescience Total Protection Face Shield Flex SPF 50](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/colorescience-total-protection-face-shield-flex-spf-50-review.html): 12% non-nano Zinc Oxide, tone-adapting encapsulated iron oxides, HEV blue light filtration.
- [EltaMD AM Restore Face Moisturizer](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/eltamd-am-restore-face-moisturizer-review.html): Niacinamide, willow bark extract, caffeine, non-greasy day restoration.
- [UV Clear Face Sunscreen SPF 46](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/uv-clear-sunscreen-review.html): 9.0% Zinc Oxide, 5% Niacinamide, lactic acid, acne and rosacea tolerance profile.
- [La Roche-Posay Toleriane Double Repair](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/la-roche-posay-toleriane-double-repair-review.html): Prebiotic thermal water, Ceramide-3, high-tolerability barrier synthesis.
- [Beekman 1802 Bloom Cream](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/beekman-1802-bloom-cream-moisturizer-review.html): Goat milk prebiotic and postbiotic microbiome support.
- [Obagi Professional-C Serum 20%](https://www.clinicaldermalab.io/obagi-professional-c-serum-review.html): 20% L-Ascorbic Acid low-pH dermal penetration and antioxidant defense.
